blind.description: A traditional small hand bell standing upright on the ground. It features a flared dark bronze or tarnished metal bell bowl accented with golden rings, a slender turned wooden handle in the middle, and a small golden brass finial knob at the top. The surface is smooth and continuous, sitting firmly on its bottom rim.
blind.from_above: A concentric circular shape with a small golden center dot (the finial) encircled by the handle rings and outer bell rim, casting a thin shadow toward the upper left.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 8 to 10 inches tall and 4 to 5 inches wide, approximately 1/8th of the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure.
